query: MATCH (c:Compound)-[:BINDS]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES]-(d:Disease {name: 'multiple sclerosis'}) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (c)-[:TREATS]->(d) } WITH c, g ORDER BY g.name WITH c, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS genes RETURN c.name AS compound, size(genes) AS genes, genes[..4] AS via ORDER BY genes DESC, compound LIMIT 10
